name: ScreenParser
notes: The model outputs boxes, class labels and confidences only, without element text; the card suggests OCR or a separate vision-language model for text. It is trained on rendered web screenshots, and the card warns that results may differ on native desktop or mobile screens. The main-branch Hub manifest holds one Ultralytics weight file, best.pt, and the card gives a 1280-pixel fine-tuning resolution. Apache-2.0 is the card's weight declaration; base-model and training-data terms are separate. The detector was not run.
summary: YOLO11-L UI element detector from IBM Research and ETH Zurich that boxes and labels 55 element classes in web screenshots; the main checkpoint is trained on ScreenParse v2 and the v1 detector stays on a branch.
